ideas.title: Following the Money in Medicaid Provider Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trails of Medicaid providers accused of fraud and track the flow of money.
questions: How much money is involved in Medicaid provider fraud?
What are the most common schemes used by fraudulent providers?
ideas.insight: By tracking the financial trails of Medicaid providers accused of fraud, we can identify patterns and connections that may lead to larger schemes and more significant recoveries.

ideas.title: Uncovering Patterns in Federal Funding Freezes
ideas.description: Investigate the reasons behind federal funding freezes and identify patterns in affected projects.
questions: What are the most common reasons for federal funding freezes?
Are there any patterns in the types of projects affected by funding freezes?
ideas.insight: By analyzing data on federal funding freezes, we can identify patterns and trends that may indicate larger issues with project management and federal funding.
